# apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_code_values (Data Source)

Reads the codes of a batch of one-time-use codes for an in-app purchase offer code, e.g. to export them. They're sensitive, so read them only where needed; they're also stored in the state of the configuration that reads them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_code_values" "batch" {
  batch_id = apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes.batch.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `batch_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the batch, e.g. `apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code_one_time_use_codes.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `codes` (List of String, Sensitive) The codes.
